title: Remove the GitHub clone route with the startup file, or keep it one more release pinned
context: The startup file (.paqad/hook.mjs) also fetches a copy of paqad from GitHub (Eliyce/paqad-claude-plugin, today the moving default branch, refreshed every 6 hours) for teammates without it. Should that route go away with the file, or stay one more release, locked to a fixed version and never refreshed while updates are off? Removing it now means one less way to install paqad to secure and test; keeping it gives teams one release to switch over but needs a locked version and a tag check on every release (#918 rule 3).
